cases.description: The claimant disputes a refusal; the resolver the terms name upholds the dispute.
cases.name: refusal-disputed-and-upheld

cases.description: The respondent disputes the evidence it was given; both parties settle by rejecting the dispute.
cases.name: evidence-disputed-and-settled

cases.description: A dispute nobody resolves stays open. The refused claim stays refused.
cases.name: dispute-left-open

cases.description: While the refusal is disputed, a new claim for the same invoice is registered.
cases.name: open-dispute-holds-the-unit

cases.description: After the refusal, a new claim for the same invoice took the unit; disputing the refusal would make two claims hold it.
cases.name: dispute-after-the-unit-was-taken

cases.description: Once the dispute of the refusal is rejected, a new claim for the same invoice is registered.
cases.name: rejected-dispute-releases-the-unit

cases.description: After the dispute of the refusal is upheld, a new claim for the same invoice is registered.
cases.name: upheld-dispute-keeps-the-unit

cases.description: A claim that is still open has nothing to dispute yet.
cases.name: open-claim-not-disputable

cases.description: A claim its claimant withdrew cannot be disputed.
cases.name: withdrawn-claim-not-disputable

cases.description: The respondent disputes the refusal it gave; only the claimant disputes a refusal.
cases.name: respondent-disputes-its-own-refusal

cases.description: The respondent's dispute of the evidence is upheld; the claimant then replaces the claim with a corrected one for the same invoice. The upheld dispute does not hold the unit: the claim's own state does.
cases.name: replaced-after-the-respondent-won

cases.description: The claimant withdraws a claim whose evidence the respondent disputes: the dispute is settled first.
cases.name: withdrawal-while-disputed

cases.description: The claimant replaces a claim whose evidence the respondent disputes: the dispute is settled first.
cases.name: supersession-while-disputed

cases.description: A claim is disputed again after its first dispute was resolved.
cases.name: disputed-twice

cases.description: The dispute is recorded 31 days after the refusal; the terms allow 30.
cases.name: late-dispute

cases.description: The dispute terms the dispute names are not supplied.
cases.name: missing-terms

cases.description: The claimant signs the dispute terms in the respondent's place.
cases.name: terms-signed-by-one-party

cases.description: The dispute terms are for another agreement than the claim's.
cases.name: terms-for-another-agreement

cases.description: The dispute terms name the respondent as resolver.
cases.name: resolver-is-a-party

cases.description: The resolver opens a dispute itself; only the parties may.
cases.name: dispute-by-a-third-party

cases.description: A dispute whose stated ground is empty.
cases.name: dispute-without-ground

cases.description: The dispute is dated after the registry recorded it.
cases.name: disputed-after-record

cases.description: The registry records a dispute of a claim it never registered.
cases.name: dispute-without-claim

cases.description: The dispute the record names is not supplied.
cases.name: missing-dispute

cases.description: The registry records a resolution for a claim that was never disputed.
cases.name: resolution-without-open-dispute

cases.description: The resolution the record names is not supplied.
cases.name: missing-resolution

cases.description: The resolution names another dispute than the one open.
cases.name: resolution-of-another-dispute

cases.description: The claimant signs a resolution as if it were the resolver.
cases.name: resolved-by-a-party-as-resolver

cases.description: A settlement the claimant signs twice, in the respondent's place too.
cases.name: settlement-signed-by-one-party

cases.description: Terms without a resolver: a resolution signed as by a resolver is refused, only a settlement can end the dispute.
cases.name: no-resolver-named

cases.description: The resolution is dated after the registry recorded it.
cases.name: resolved-after-record

cases.description: A claim for other work is registered while the dispute is open. The dispute is still open afterwards, and is resolved.
cases.name: dispute-resolved-after-another-registration

description: Audits of logs with disputes. Keys are those of vectors.json, with a resolver's key added to this file's trust configuration.
